summary: Lexicon Pharmaceuticals filed an 8-K reporting entry into a loan and security agreement with Hercules Capital for up to $100 million in borrowing capacity across three tranches. The first $55 million tranche was funded at closing. The loans mature in May 2030, bear interest at prime plus 3.10% (floor 9.85%), and feature interest-only periods tied to clinical and regulatory milestones for sotagliflozin in hypertrophic cardiomyopathy. This is a debt financing arrangement, not a special situation event. No change in control, acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, or activist campaign is involved. The filing is a routine material agreement disclosure.
